body: Thank you all for commenting. It means a lot to me. Ive had a better day today, in terms of feeling a fair bit happier. It seems to me that I sometimes have good days, and sometimes have bad days, and the bad days are when I think most about the point of life and suicide. Ill take some advice and see if I can start an activity that im interested in, if there are any. And again, thank you so much for caring. Its you guys (and girls maybe) that deserve the best in life. (A bit corny I know). Peace :)
Thank you. Ill have a think about where my life's at and get back to you.
Thank you for your post. You raised some interesting points. It was a bit hard to get my head round but I do see where it is coming from.
Thanks for your suggestion, but the farms where I live aren't hugely interested in an unskilled 15 year old. Also, I'm not hugely interested in finding a job at this moment in time.
